question: Which suppliers do we hold the most stock from?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS units_on_hand FROM pg.suppliers.suppliers s JOIN pg.inventory.warehouse_inventory i ON i.supplier_id = s.supplier_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY units_on_hand DESC

question: How many units are on order from suppliers in each region?
referenceSql: SELECT s.region, COUNT(*) AS open_orders, SUM(p.qty_ordered) AS units_on_order FROM pg.procurement.purchase_orders p JOIN pg.suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY units_on_order DESC

question: Which in-transit purchase orders arrive first, and from which supplier and carrier?
referenceSql: SELECT p.po_id, p.sku, s.name AS supplier, h.carrier, h.eta_date FROM pg.procurement.purchase_orders p JOIN pg.suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN pg.inventory.shipments h ON h.po_id = p.po_id WHERE p.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' ORDER BY h.eta_date

question: How many shipments does each carrier have?
referenceSql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS shipments FROM pg.inventory.shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY shipments DESC

question: How much stock is in each warehouse?
referenceSql: SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(qty_on_hand) AS units FROM pg.inventory.warehouse_inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id

question: Which parts in the JM-200 joint module are custom and which are catalog items?
referenceSql: SELECT b.line_no, p.part_no, p.description, p.source_type, b.qty_per FROM pg.inventory.bom_lines b JOIN pg.inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = b.part_no WHERE b.assembly_no = 'JM-200' ORDER BY b.line_no

question: Which parts have only one supplier quote, and where is that supplier?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, p.description, MIN(s.name) AS supplier, MIN(s.country) AS country FROM pg.procurement.rfqs r JOIN pg.procurement.quotes q ON q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id JOIN pg.suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id JOIN pg.inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = r.part_no GROUP BY r.part_no, p.description HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which quotes would miss the need date if we ordered on the quote date?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, s.name AS supplier, q.lead_time_days, q.promise_date, r.need_date FROM pg.procurement.quotes q JOIN pg.procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN pg.suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id WHERE q.promise_date > r.need_date ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which quotes come from a supplier that cannot hold the tolerance the part needs?
referenceSql: SELECT r.part_no, p.tolerance_mm AS needed_mm, s.name AS supplier, c.min_tolerance_mm AS supplier_best_mm FROM pg.procurement.quotes q JOIN pg.procurement.rfqs r ON r.rfq_id = q.rfq_id JOIN pg.inventory.parts p ON p.part_no = r.part_no JOIN pg.suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = q.supplier_id JOIN pg.suppliers.supplier_capabilities c ON c.supplier_id = q.supplier_id AND c.process = p.process AND c.material = p.material WHERE c.min_tolerance_mm > p.tolerance_mm ORDER BY r.part_no

question: Which custom parts could be replaced by a catalog item, and what does each cost against the best quote?
referenceSql: SELECT p.part_no, p.description, e.catalog_sku, e.match_confidence, c.unit_price_usd AS catalog_price, MIN(q.unit_price_usd) AS best_quote FROM pg.inventory.parts p JOIN pg.inventory.part_equivalences e ON e.part_no = p.part_no JOIN pg.inventory.catalog_items c ON c.catalog_sku = e.catalog_sku JOIN pg.procurement.rfqs r ON r.part_no = p.part_no JOIN pg.procurement.quotes q ON q.rfq_id = r.rfq_id WHERE p.source_type = 'CUSTOM' GROUP BY p.part_no, p.description, e.catalog_sku, e.match_confidence, c.unit_price_usd ORDER BY e.match_confidence DESC

question: Which suppliers are AS9100 certified, and when does it expire?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, c.expires_on FROM pg.suppliers.suppliers s JOIN pg.suppliers.supplier_certifications c ON c.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE c.certification = 'AS9100' ORDER BY c.expires_on

question: Which business services had an outage longer than their recovery time objective in the last 12 months?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS service, s.tier, i.started_on, i.duration_minutes, s.rto_minutes FROM pg.risk.incidents i JOIN pg.risk.applications a ON a.app_id = i.app_id JOIN pg.risk.business_services s ON s.service_id = a.service_id WHERE i.duration_minutes > s.rto_minutes AND i.started_on >= CURRENT_DATE - 365 ORDER BY s.tier, i.duration_minutes DESC

question: How many minutes of downtime did each business service have in the last 12 months?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS service, s.tier, SUM(i.duration_minutes) AS downtime_minutes, COUNT(*) AS outages FROM pg.risk.incidents i JOIN pg.risk.applications a ON a.app_id = i.app_id JOIN pg.risk.business_services s ON s.service_id = a.service_id WHERE i.started_on >= CURRENT_DATE - 365 GROUP BY s.name, s.tier ORDER BY downtime_minutes DESC

question: What are the leading root causes of outages, by total downtime?
referenceSql: SELECT root_cause, COUNT(*) AS outages, SUM(duration_minutes) AS downtime_minutes FROM pg.risk.incidents WHERE started_on >= CURRENT_DATE - 365 GROUP BY root_cause ORDER BY downtime_minutes DESC

question: Which risks are above the board's risk appetite for their category?
referenceSql: SELECT r.title, r.category, r.owner, r.residual_score, a.max_residual_score AS appetite FROM pg.risk.risk_register r JOIN pg.risk.risk_appetite a ON a.category = r.category WHERE r.residual_score > a.max_residual_score AND r.status <> 'Closed' ORDER BY r.residual_score - a.max_residual_score DESC, r.title

question: Which risks are above appetite and have a control that is overdue for testing or rated ineffective?
referenceSql: SELECT DISTINCT r.title, r.residual_score, c.title AS control, c.last_result, c.last_tested FROM pg.risk.risk_register r JOIN pg.risk.risk_appetite a ON a.category = r.category JOIN pg.risk.controls c ON c.risk_id = r.risk_id WHERE r.residual_score > a.max_residual_score AND (c.last_result = 'Ineffective' OR c.last_tested < CURRENT_DATE - c.test_every_days) ORDER BY r.residual_score DESC, r.title

question: Which critical vulnerabilities are past their patch deadline, and which business service does each affect?
referenceSql: SELECT v.cve, v.cvss, a.name AS application, s.name AS service, s.tier, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, v.patch_due, CURRENT_DATE) AS days_overdue FROM mdb.security.vulnerabilities v JOIN pg.risk.applications a ON a.app_id = v.app_id JOIN pg.risk.business_services s ON s.service_id = a.service_id WHERE v.severity = 'Critical' AND v.patched_on IS NULL AND v.patch_due < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY days_overdue DESC

question: Which key risk indicators are in red, and what is their latest reading?
referenceSql: SELECT k.name, k.category, r.reading AS latest_reading, k.red_at FROM pg.risk.key_risk_indicators k JOIN pg.risk.kri_readings r ON r.kri_id = k.kri_id WHERE r.month_start = (SELECT MAX(month_start) FROM pg.risk.kri_readings x WHERE x.kri_id = k.kri_id) AND ((k.higher_is_worse AND r.reading >= k.red_at) OR (NOT k.higher_is_worse AND r.reading <= k.red_at)) ORDER BY k.name

question: Which critical third parties have not been assessed in the last 12 months, and which services do they support?
referenceSql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, v.last_assessed, v.assessment_rating, s.name AS service, s.tier FROM mdb.security.vendors v JOIN pg.risk.applications a ON a.vendor_id = v.vendor_id JOIN pg.risk.business_services s ON s.service_id = a.service_id WHERE v.tier = 1 AND v.last_assessed < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365' DAY ORDER BY v.name, s.name

question: Which vendors support the most tier-1 services?
referenceSql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, v.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT s.service_id) AS tier1_services, COUNT(DISTINCT a.app_id) AS applications FROM mdb.security.vendors v JOIN pg.risk.applications a ON a.vendor_id = v.vendor_id JOIN pg.risk.business_services s ON s.service_id = a.service_id WHERE s.tier = 1 GROUP BY v.name, v.tier ORDER BY tier1_services DESC, v.name

question: Which audit issues are overdue, and which risk does each relate to?
referenceSql: SELECT i.title AS issue, i.severity, i.due_on, CURRENT_DATE - i.due_on AS days_overdue, r.title AS risk, i.owner FROM pg.risk.audit_issues i JOIN pg.risk.risk_register r ON r.risk_id = i.risk_id WHERE i.status = 'Open' AND i.due_on < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY days_overdue DESC

question: Which tier-1 services have both an open critical vulnerability and an outage in the last 90 days?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS service, v.open_critical_vulns, o.outage_minutes FROM pg.risk.business_services s JOIN (SELECT a.service_id, COUNT(*) AS open_critical_vulns FROM mdb.security.vulnerabilities x JOIN pg.risk.applications a ON a.app_id = x.app_id WHERE x.severity = 'Critical' AND x.patched_on IS NULL GROUP BY a.service_id) v ON v.service_id = s.service_id JOIN (SELECT a.service_id, SUM(i.duration_minutes) AS outage_minutes FROM pg.risk.incidents i JOIN pg.risk.applications a ON a.app_id = i.app_id WHERE i.started_on >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90' DAY GROUP BY a.service_id) o ON o.service_id = s.service_id WHERE s.tier = 1 ORDER BY s.name

question: How much revenue was at risk from outages in the last 12 months, by business service?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS service, ROUND(SUM(i.duration_minutes) / 60.0 * s.revenue_per_hour_usd) AS revenue_at_risk_usd FROM pg.risk.incidents i JOIN pg.risk.applications a ON a.app_id = i.app_id JOIN pg.risk.business_services s ON s.service_id = a.service_id WHERE i.started_on >= CURRENT_DATE - 365 GROUP BY s.name, s.revenue_per_hour_usd ORDER BY revenue_at_risk_usd DESC

question: What do we hold on the American Civil War across all museums, and how much of it has an image?
referenceSql: SELECT unit_code AS museum, COUNT(DISTINCT record_id) AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT record_id) FILTER (WHERE image_url IS NOT NULL) AS with_image FROM pg.smithsonian.si_topics WHERE concept = 'American Civil War (1861-1865)' GROUP BY unit_code ORDER BY records DESC

question: Which museums have the most records with no image?
referenceSql: SELECT unit_code AS museum, COUNT(DISTINCT record_id) AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT record_id) FILTER (WHERE image_url IS NULL) AS without_image FROM pg.smithsonian.si_topics GROUP BY unit_code ORDER BY without_image DESC

question: Show me what the Smithsonian has about the Civil War
referenceSql: SELECT DISTINCT title, unit_code AS museum, image_url, record_link FROM pg.smithsonian.si_topics WHERE concept = 'American Civil War (1861-1865)' AND image_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY title LIMIT 24

question: Show me portraits from the National Portrait Gallery
referenceSql: SELECT DISTINCT title, unit_code AS museum, image_url, record_link FROM pg.smithsonian.si_topics WHERE unit_code = 'NPG' AND topic = 'Portraits' AND image_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY title LIMIT 24

question: How many records does each museum hold, with its full name and department?
referenceSql: SELECT m.museum_name, m.department, COUNT(DISTINCT t.record_id) AS records FROM pg.smithsonian.si_topics t JOIN files.museums m ON t.unit_code = m.unit_code GROUP BY m.museum_name, m.department ORDER BY records DESC

question: Which parts are in the KR-6 robot arm, and how many of each does it use?
referenceSql: SELECT p.part_no, p.name, p.source_type, SUM(bl.quantity) AS quantity FROM pg.bom.bom_lines bl JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = bl.part_no WHERE pr.sku = 'KR-6' GROUP BY p.part_no, p.name, p.source_type ORDER BY p.part_no

question: How many custom, catalog and standard parts does each product have?
referenceSql: SELECT pr.sku, p.source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT p.part_no) AS parts FROM pg.bom.products pr JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.product_id = pr.product_id JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = bl.part_no GROUP BY pr.sku, p.source_type ORDER BY pr.sku, p.source_type

question: What is each product's unit BOM cost at its current sources, including tariffs, compared with its target cost?
referenceSql: SELECT pr.sku, ROUND(SUM(bl.quantity * q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS unit_bom_cost, pr.target_unit_cost, ROUND(SUM(bl.quantity * q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0)) - pr.target_unit_cost, 2) AS over_target FROM pg.bom.products pr JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.product_id = pr.product_id JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.quotes q ON q.part_no = bl.part_no AND q.is_current_source GROUP BY pr.sku, pr.target_unit_cost ORDER BY pr.sku

question: Which material is used by the most parts?
referenceSql: SELECT m.name AS material, COUNT(*) AS parts FROM pg.bom.parts p JOIN pg.bom.materials m ON m.material_id = p.material_id GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY parts DESC, m.name LIMIT 5

question: Which facilities hold a valid AS9100 certificate today?
referenceSql: SELECT f.name AS facility, f.country, fc.expires_on FROM pg.bom.facilities f JOIN pg.bom.facility_certifications fc ON fc.facility_id = f.facility_id JOIN pg.bom.certifications c ON c.certification_id = fc.certification_id WHERE c.code = 'AS9100' AND fc.expires_on >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY f.name

question: Which facilities are running at 95% utilization or higher?
referenceSql: SELECT name AS facility, city, utilization_pct FROM pg.bom.facilities WHERE utilization_pct >= 95 ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC

question: Which supply disruptions are active right now, and which facility does each affect?
referenceSql: SELECT e.event_type, e.severity, f.name AS facility, e.started_on, e.note FROM pg.bom.supply_events e JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = e.facility_id WHERE e.status = 'Active' ORDER BY CASE e.severity WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, e.started_on

question: Which parts have only one supplier quote, and which facility is it from?
referenceSql: SELECT q.part_no, p.name, MIN(f.name) AS facility FROM pg.bom.quotes q JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = q.part_no JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = q.facility_id GROUP BY q.part_no, p.name HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ORDER BY q.part_no

question: A fire hit our Shenzhen plant. Which parts do we currently source there, and which products do they go into?
referenceSql: SELECT q.part_no, p.name, pr.sku AS product, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg.bom.quotes q2 WHERE q2.part_no = q.part_no AND q2.facility_id <> q.facility_id) AS alternative_quotes FROM pg.bom.quotes q JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = q.facility_id JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = q.part_no JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.part_no = q.part_no JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE q.is_current_source AND f.name = 'Shenzhen Plant' GROUP BY q.part_no, p.name, pr.sku, q.facility_id ORDER BY q.part_no, pr.sku

question: Which engineering change orders are still open or in review, and which products does each touch?
referenceSql: SELECT e.eco_id, e.part_no, e.change_type, e.status, pr.sku AS product, a.name AS assembly FROM pg.bom.engineering_changes e JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.part_no = e.part_no JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE e.status IN ('Open', 'In review') ORDER BY e.eco_id, pr.sku

question: Which parts of the SK-9 are currently sourced from a facility without a valid AS9100 certificate?
referenceSql: SELECT p.part_no, p.name, f.name AS facility FROM pg.bom.quotes q JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = q.part_no JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = q.facility_id JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.part_no = p.part_no JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE pr.sku = 'SK-9' AND q.is_current_source AND p.source_type = 'custom' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.facility_certifications fc JOIN pg.bom.certifications c ON c.certification_id = fc.certification_id WHERE fc.facility_id = f.facility_id AND c.code = 'AS9100' AND fc.expires_on >= CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.part_no, p.name, f.name ORDER BY p.part_no

question: What was the total cost of nonconformances by root cause?
referenceSql: SELECT root_cause, COUNT(*) AS reports, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_cost FROM pg.bom.nonconformances GROUP BY root_cause ORDER BY total_cost DESC

question: Which suppliers deliver late most often, and what share of their purchase orders arrived after the promised date?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, COUNT(*) AS orders_received, SUM(CASE WHEN po.received_date > po.promised_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN po.received_date > po.promised_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_pct FROM pg.bom.purchase_orders po JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = po.facility_id JOIN pg.bom.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = f.supplier_id WHERE po.received_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY late_pct DESC, s.name

question: Which parts are below their safety stock, and where are they held?
referenceSql: SELECT i.part_no, p.name, f.name AS facility, i.on_hand, i.safety_stock FROM pg.bom.inventory i JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = i.part_no JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = i.facility_id WHERE i.on_hand < i.safety_stock ORDER BY i.safety_stock - i.on_hand DESC, i.part_no

question: What is the scrap rate at each facility?
referenceSql: SELECT f.name AS facility, SUM(w.quantity) AS units_made, SUM(w.scrap_quantity) AS units_scrapped, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(w.scrap_quantity) / SUM(w.quantity), 2) AS scrap_pct FROM pg.bom.work_orders w JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = w.facility_id GROUP BY f.name ORDER BY scrap_pct DESC

question: Which suppliers has Kestrel Dynamics not yet approved?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, av.status FROM pg.bom.approved_vendors av JOIN pg.bom.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = av.supplier_id JOIN pg.bom.customers c ON c.customer_id = av.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Kestrel Dynamics' AND av.status <> 'approved' ORDER BY s.name

question: Which current-source part has the longest lead time for each product?
referenceSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (pr.sku) pr.sku, q.part_no, p.name, q.lead_time_days FROM pg.bom.quotes q JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = q.part_no JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.part_no = q.part_no JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE q.is_current_source ORDER BY pr.sku, q.lead_time_days DESC, q.part_no

question: Which custom parts could be replaced by a configurable catalog item, and how much would each save per unit?
referenceSql: WITH fit AS (SELECT p.part_no, p.name, ci.sku AS catalog_item, q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0) AS current_cost, ci.unit_price AS catalog_price FROM pg.bom.parts p JOIN pg.bom.quotes q ON q.part_no = p.part_no AND q.is_current_source JOIN pg.bom.catalog_items ci ON ci.material_id = p.material_id AND ci.shape = p.shape AND ci.finish = p.finish AND ci.min_tolerance_mm <= p.tolerance_mm AND ci.max_length_mm >= p.length_mm AND ci.max_width_mm >= p.width_mm AND ci.max_height_mm >= p.height_mm WHERE p.source_type = 'custom' AND NOT p.is_critical AND ci.unit_price < q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0) AND (ci.distributor_certification = 'AS9120' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.bom_lines bl JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE bl.part_no = p.part_no AND pr.required_certification = 'AS9100'))) SELECT DISTINCT ON (part_no) part_no, name, catalog_item, ROUND(current_cost, 2) AS current_cost, catalog_price, ROUND(current_cost - catalog_price, 2) AS saving_per_unit FROM fit ORDER BY part_no, catalog_price

question: How much would those catalog replacements save per year, using each product's annual volume?
referenceSql: WITH fit AS (SELECT p.part_no, p.name, ci.sku AS catalog_item, q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0) AS current_cost, ci.unit_price AS catalog_price FROM pg.bom.parts p JOIN pg.bom.quotes q ON q.part_no = p.part_no AND q.is_current_source JOIN pg.bom.catalog_items ci ON ci.material_id = p.material_id AND ci.shape = p.shape AND ci.finish = p.finish AND ci.min_tolerance_mm <= p.tolerance_mm AND ci.max_length_mm >= p.length_mm AND ci.max_width_mm >= p.width_mm AND ci.max_height_mm >= p.height_mm WHERE p.source_type = 'custom' AND NOT p.is_critical AND ci.unit_price < q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0) AND (ci.distributor_certification = 'AS9120' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.bom_lines bl JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE bl.part_no = p.part_no AND pr.required_certification = 'AS9100'))), best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (part_no) * FROM fit ORDER BY part_no, catalog_price) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.part_no) AS parts_replaced, ROUND(SUM((b.current_cost - b.catalog_price) * bl.quantity * pr.annual_volume), 0) AS annual_saving FROM best b JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.part_no = b.part_no JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id

question: Which custom parts cannot be replaced by a catalog item, and what rules them out?
referenceSql: WITH fit AS (SELECT p.part_no, p.name, ci.sku AS catalog_item, q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0) AS current_cost, ci.unit_price AS catalog_price FROM pg.bom.parts p JOIN pg.bom.quotes q ON q.part_no = p.part_no AND q.is_current_source JOIN pg.bom.catalog_items ci ON ci.material_id = p.material_id AND ci.shape = p.shape AND ci.finish = p.finish AND ci.min_tolerance_mm <= p.tolerance_mm AND ci.max_length_mm >= p.length_mm AND ci.max_width_mm >= p.width_mm AND ci.max_height_mm >= p.height_mm WHERE p.source_type = 'custom' AND NOT p.is_critical AND ci.unit_price < q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0) AND (ci.distributor_certification = 'AS9120' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.bom_lines bl JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE bl.part_no = p.part_no AND pr.required_certification = 'AS9100'))) SELECT p.part_no, p.name, CASE WHEN p.is_critical THEN 'critical part' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.catalog_items ci WHERE ci.material_id = p.material_id) THEN 'no catalog item in this material' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.catalog_items ci WHERE ci.material_id = p.material_id AND ci.shape = p.shape) THEN 'no catalog item of this type' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.catalog_items ci WHERE ci.material_id = p.material_id AND ci.shape = p.shape AND ci.finish = p.finish) THEN 'no catalog item with this finish' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.catalog_items ci WHERE ci.material_id = p.material_id AND ci.shape = p.shape AND ci.max_length_mm >= p.length_mm AND ci.max_width_mm >= p.width_mm AND ci.max_height_mm >= p.height_mm) THEN 'too large for any catalog item' ELSE 'tolerance, certification or price rules it out' END AS reason FROM pg.bom.parts p WHERE p.source_type = 'custom' AND p.part_no NOT IN (SELECT part_no FROM fit) ORDER BY p.part_no

question: To bring the SK-9 under AS9100 and within North America, which facility is cheapest for each custom part?
referenceSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.part_no) q.part_no, p.name, f.name AS facility, ROUND(q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0), 2) AS landed_cost, q.lead_time_days FROM pg.bom.quotes q JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = q.part_no JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = q.facility_id JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.part_no = q.part_no JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE pr.sku = 'SK-9' AND p.source_type = 'custom' AND f.region = 'North America' AND f.utilization_pct < 95
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.facility_certifications fc JOIN pg.bom.certifications c ON c.certification_id = fc.certification_id
                  WHERE fc.facility_id = f.facility_id AND c.code = 'AS9100' AND fc.expires_on >= CURRENT_DATE)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.supply_events e WHERE e.facility_id = f.facility_id AND e.status = 'Active' AND e.severity = 'High')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.approved_vendors av WHERE av.supplier_id = f.supplier_id AND av.customer_id = 1 AND av.status = 'approved') ORDER BY q.part_no, q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0)

question: Which SK-9 custom parts have no North American source that holds a valid AS9100 certificate and has capacity?
referenceSql:
SELECT p.part_no, p.name FROM pg.bom.parts p JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.part_no = p.part_no JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE pr.sku = 'SK-9' AND p.source_type = 'custom' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.quotes q JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = q.facility_id WHERE q.part_no = p.part_no AND f.region = 'North America' AND f.utilization_pct < 95
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.facility_certifications fc JOIN pg.bom.certifications c ON c.certification_id = fc.certification_id
                  WHERE fc.facility_id = f.facility_id AND c.code = 'AS9100' AND fc.expires_on >= CURRENT_DATE)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.supply_events e WHERE e.facility_id = f.facility_id AND e.status = 'Active' AND e.severity = 'High')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.approved_vendors av WHERE av.supplier_id = f.supplier_id AND av.customer_id = 1 AND av.status = 'approved')) GROUP BY p.part_no, p.name ORDER BY p.part_no

question: If we moved every SK-9 custom part that has a compliant North American source to it, how would the SK-9 unit BOM cost change?
referenceSql:
WITH sk AS (SELECT bl.part_no, SUM(bl.quantity) AS qty FROM pg.bom.bom_lines bl JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE pr.sku = 'SK-9' GROUP BY bl.part_no), cur AS (SELECT sk.part_no, sk.qty, q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0) AS c FROM sk JOIN pg.bom.quotes q ON q.part_no = sk.part_no AND q.is_current_source), alt AS (SELECT q.part_no, MIN(q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0)) AS c FROM pg.bom.quotes q JOIN pg.bom.facilities f ON f.facility_id = q.facility_id JOIN sk ON sk.part_no = q.part_no WHERE f.region = 'North America' AND f.utilization_pct < 95
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.facility_certifications fc JOIN pg.bom.certifications c ON c.certification_id = fc.certification_id
                  WHERE fc.facility_id = f.facility_id AND c.code = 'AS9100' AND fc.expires_on >= CURRENT_DATE)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.supply_events e WHERE e.facility_id = f.facility_id AND e.status = 'Active' AND e.severity = 'High')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg.bom.approved_vendors av WHERE av.supplier_id = f.supplier_id AND av.customer_id = 1 AND av.status = 'approved') GROUP BY q.part_no) SELECT ROUND(SUM(cur.qty * cur.c), 2) AS current_unit_cost, ROUND(SUM(cur.qty * COALESCE(alt.c, cur.c)), 2) AS resourced_unit_cost, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(cur.qty * COALESCE(alt.c, cur.c)) - SUM(cur.qty * cur.c)) / SUM(cur.qty * cur.c), 1) AS change_pct, COUNT(alt.part_no) AS parts_with_compliant_source FROM cur LEFT JOIN alt ON alt.part_no = cur.part_no

question: Which DFM findings would save money on the KR-6 with no performance impact, and how much per unit?
referenceSql: SELECT d.part_no, p.name, d.recommendation, d.saving_pct, ROUND(SUM(bl.quantity) * q.unit_cost * (1 + q.tariff_pct / 100.0) * d.saving_pct / 100.0, 2) AS saving_per_robot FROM pg.bom.dfm_findings d JOIN pg.bom.parts p ON p.part_no = d.part_no JOIN pg.bom.quotes q ON q.part_no = d.part_no AND q.is_current_source JOIN pg.bom.bom_lines bl ON bl.part_no = d.part_no JOIN pg.bom.assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = bl.assembly_id JOIN pg.bom.products pr ON pr.product_id = a.product_id WHERE pr.sku = 'KR-6' AND d.performance_impact = 'None' GROUP BY d.part_no, p.name, d.recommendation, d.saving_pct, q.unit_cost, q.tariff_pct ORDER BY saving_per_robot DESC

question: What is our consolidated cash position in US dollars across all open accounts?
referenceSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts, ROUND(SUM(usd), 0) AS total_usd FROM (SELECT a.account_id, a.entity_id, a.bank_id, a.currency, a.account_type, a.status, a.feed_method, b.as_of_date, b.ledger_balance,
        b.ledger_balance * r.rate_to_usd AS usd
     FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts a
     JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM pg.treasury.balances GROUP BY account_id) l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN pg.treasury.balances b ON b.account_id = l.account_id AND b.as_of_date = l.d
     JOIN pg.treasury.fx_rates r ON r.currency = a.currency) x WHERE status = 'Open'

question: How much cash do we hold in each currency, in the local currency and in US dollars?
referenceSql:
SELECT currency, ROUND(SUM(ledger_balance), 0) AS local_amount, ROUND(SUM(usd), 0) AS usd_amount FROM (SELECT a.account_id, a.entity_id, a.bank_id, a.currency, a.account_type, a.status, a.feed_method, b.as_of_date, b.ledger_balance,
        b.ledger_balance * r.rate_to_usd AS usd
     FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts a
     JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM pg.treasury.balances GROUP BY account_id) l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN pg.treasury.balances b ON b.account_id = l.account_id AND b.as_of_date = l.d
     JOIN pg.treasury.fx_rates r ON r.currency = a.currency) x WHERE status = 'Open' GROUP BY currency ORDER BY usd_amount DESC

question: What is the cash position of each legal entity in US dollars?
referenceSql:
SELECT e.name AS entity, ROUND(SUM(x.usd), 0) AS usd_amount FROM (SELECT a.account_id, a.entity_id, a.bank_id, a.currency, a.account_type, a.status, a.feed_method, b.as_of_date, b.ledger_balance,
        b.ledger_balance * r.rate_to_usd AS usd
     FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts a
     JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM pg.treasury.balances GROUP BY account_id) l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN pg.treasury.balances b ON b.account_id = l.account_id AND b.as_of_date = l.d
     JOIN pg.treasury.fx_rates r ON r.currency = a.currency) x JOIN pg.treasury.entities e ON e.entity_id = x.entity_id WHERE x.status = 'Open' GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY usd_amount DESC

question: How much cash is held at each bank, and what share of the total is that?
referenceSql:
SELECT bk.name AS bank, ROUND(SUM(x.usd), 0) AS usd_amount, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(x.usd) / (SELECT SUM(usd) FROM (SELECT a.account_id, a.entity_id, a.bank_id, a.currency, a.account_type, a.status, a.feed_method, b.as_of_date, b.ledger_balance,
        b.ledger_balance * r.rate_to_usd AS usd
     FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts a
     JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM pg.treasury.balances GROUP BY account_id) l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN pg.treasury.balances b ON b.account_id = l.account_id AND b.as_of_date = l.d
     JOIN pg.treasury.fx_rates r ON r.currency = a.currency) y WHERE y.status = 'Open'), 1) AS share_pct FROM (SELECT a.account_id, a.entity_id, a.bank_id, a.currency, a.account_type, a.status, a.feed_method, b.as_of_date, b.ledger_balance,
        b.ledger_balance * r.rate_to_usd AS usd
     FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts a
     JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM pg.treasury.balances GROUP BY account_id) l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN pg.treasury.balances b ON b.account_id = l.account_id AND b.as_of_date = l.d
     JOIN pg.treasury.fx_rates r ON r.currency = a.currency) x JOIN pg.treasury.banks bk ON bk.bank_id = x.bank_id WHERE x.status = 'Open' GROUP BY bk.name ORDER BY usd_amount DESC

question: Which accounts have a balance that is more than a day old?
referenceSql: SELECT a.account_no, a.currency, a.feed_method, a.status, MAX(b.as_of_date) AS latest_balance FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts a JOIN pg.treasury.balances b ON b.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_no, a.currency, a.feed_method, a.status HAVING MAX(b.as_of_date) < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY ORDER BY latest_balance, a.account_no

question: How much cash is trapped in frozen or restricted accounts, in US dollars?
referenceSql:
SELECT x.account_type, x.status, x.currency, ROUND(x.ledger_balance, 0) AS local_amount, ROUND(x.usd, 0) AS usd_amount FROM (SELECT a.account_id, a.entity_id, a.bank_id, a.currency, a.account_type, a.status, a.feed_method, b.as_of_date, b.ledger_balance,
        b.ledger_balance * r.rate_to_usd AS usd
     FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts a
     JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM pg.treasury.balances GROUP BY account_id) l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN pg.treasury.balances b ON b.account_id = l.account_id AND b.as_of_date = l.d
     JOIN pg.treasury.fx_rates r ON r.currency = a.currency) x WHERE x.status = 'Frozen' OR x.account_type = 'Restricted'

question: How many open accounts are fed by API, file and portal?
referenceSql: SELECT feed_method, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts WHERE status <> 'Closed' GROUP BY feed_method ORDER BY accounts DESC

question: Which ledger entries have been waiting more than 5 days to be reconciled, by entity?
referenceSql: SELECT e.name AS entity, COUNT(*) AS entries, MIN(l.posting_date) AS oldest FROM mdb.erp.ledger_entries l JOIN pg.treasury.entities e ON e.entity_id = l.entity_id WHERE l.reconciled = FALSE AND l.posting_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5' DAY GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY entries DESC

question: Which bank transactions in the last 14 days have no matching ledger entry, by account?
referenceSql: SELECT a.account_no, a.currency, COUNT(*) AS unmatched, ROUND(SUM(ABS(t.amount)), 0) AS gross_amount FROM pg.treasury.bank_transactions t JOIN pg.treasury.bank_accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.matched_ledger_id IS NULL AND t.booking_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY a.account_no, a.currency ORDER BY unmatched DESC, a.account_no

question: How many ledger entries are still unreconciled even though the bank has already booked the transaction, by entity?
referenceSql: SELECT e.name AS entity, COUNT(*) AS entries FROM pg.treasury.bank_transactions t JOIN mdb.erp.ledger_entries l ON l.entry_id = t.matched_ledger_id JOIN pg.treasury.entities e ON e.entity_id = l.entity_id WHERE l.reconciled = FALSE GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY entries DESC, e.name

question: What invoices fall due in the next 14 days, by currency?
referenceSql: SELECT i.currency, COUNT(*) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS amount FROM mdb.erp.invoices i WHERE i.status IN ('Open', 'Approved', 'On hold') AND i.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND i.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY i.currency ORDER BY amount DESC

question: Which invoices are in a different currency from the one in the vendor's contract?
referenceSql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, v.contract_currency, i.invoice_no, i.currency AS invoiced_in, i.amount, i.invoice_date FROM mdb.erp.invoices i JOIN mdb.erp.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id WHERE i.currency <> v.contract_currency ORDER BY v.name, i.invoice_date

question: Are there possible duplicate invoices, with the same vendor, amount and date?
referenceSql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, i.amount, i.currency, i.invoice_date, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM mdb.erp.invoices i JOIN mdb.erp.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id GROUP BY v.name, i.amount, i.currency, i.invoice_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY v.name

question: Which open or approved invoices have no purchase order?
referenceSql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, i.invoice_no, i.amount, i.currency, i.invoice_date FROM mdb.erp.invoices i JOIN mdb.erp.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id WHERE i.po_number IS NULL AND i.status IN ('Open', 'Approved') ORDER BY i.invoice_date DESC

question: Which payments are waiting for approval, and how much is each in US dollars?
referenceSql: SELECT p.payment_id, e.name AS entity, p.amount, p.currency, p.amount_usd, p.value_date, p.initiated_by FROM pg.treasury.payments p JOIN pg.treasury.entities e ON e.entity_id = p.entity_id WHERE p.status = 'Pending approval' ORDER BY p.amount_usd DESC

question: Which released payments were above the dual-approval limit without a second approver?
referenceSql: SELECT p.payment_id, e.name AS entity, p.amount_usd, p.approved_by, p.second_approver, p.value_date FROM pg.treasury.payments p JOIN pg.treasury.entities e ON e.entity_id = p.entity_id JOIN pg.treasury.payment_policies pol ON pol.policy_id = p.policy_id WHERE p.status = 'Released' AND p.amount_usd > pol.dual_approval_above_usd AND p.second_approver IS NULL ORDER BY p.amount_usd DESC

question: What did the treasury agent do outside policy in the last 30 days?
referenceSql: SELECT a.occurred_at, a.action_type, a.detail, a.approved_by FROM pg.treasury.agent_actions a WHERE a.within_policy = FALSE AND a.occurred_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' DAY ORDER BY a.occurred_at DESC

question: Which payments waiting for approval are for invoices that are on hold?
referenceSql: SELECT p.payment_id, v.name AS vendor, i.invoice_no, p.amount_usd FROM pg.treasury.payments p JOIN mdb.erp.invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id JOIN mdb.erp.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id WHERE p.status = 'Pending approval' AND i.status = 'On hold' ORDER BY p.amount_usd DESC

question: For each foreign currency, how much of our open payables is covered by active hedges?
referenceSql: SELECT pay.currency, pay.payable, COALESCE(h.hedged, 0) AS hedged, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(h.hedged, 0) / pay.payable, 0) AS coverage_pct FROM (SELECT i.currency, SUM(i.amount) AS payable FROM mdb.erp.invoices i WHERE i.status IN ('Open', 'Approved', 'On hold') AND i.currency <> 'USD' GROUP BY i.currency) pay LEFT JOIN (SELECT currency, SUM(notional) AS hedged FROM pg.treasury.hedges WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY currency) h ON h.currency = pay.currency ORDER BY coverage_pct, pay.currency

question: Which hedges mature in the next 30 days?
referenceSql: SELECT h.hedge_id, e.name AS entity, h.currency, h.notional, h.rate, h.maturity_date, bk.name AS bank FROM pg.treasury.hedges h JOIN pg.treasury.entities e ON e.entity_id = h.entity_id JOIN pg.treasury.banks bk ON bk.bank_id = h.bank_id WHERE h.status = 'Active' AND h.maturity_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND h.maturity_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30' DAY ORDER BY h.maturity_date

question: How much headroom does each covenant have, tightest first?
referenceSql: SELECT f.name AS facility, c.name AS covenant, c.test_type, c.threshold, c.current_value, ROUND(100.0 * CASE WHEN c.test_type = 'Maximum' THEN c.threshold - c.current_value ELSE c.current_value - c.threshold END / c.threshold, 1) AS headroom_pct FROM pg.treasury.covenants c JOIN pg.treasury.debt_facilities f ON f.facility_id = c.facility_id ORDER BY headroom_pct, c.covenant_id

question: What is our total liquidity: cash in open accounts plus undrawn revolving credit, in US dollars?
referenceSql:
SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(usd) FROM (SELECT a.account_id, a.entity_id, a.bank_id, a.currency, a.account_type, a.status, a.feed_method, b.as_of_date, b.ledger_balance,
        b.ledger_balance * r.rate_to_usd AS usd
     FROM pg.treasury.bank_accounts a
     JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS d FROM pg.treasury.balances GROUP BY account_id) l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN pg.treasury.balances b ON b.account_id = l.account_id AND b.as_of_date = l.d
     JOIN pg.treasury.fx_rates r ON r.currency = a.currency) x WHERE x.status = 'Open'), 0) AS cash_usd, ROUND((SELECT SUM((f.commitment - f.drawn) * r.rate_to_usd) FROM pg.treasury.debt_facilities f JOIN pg.treasury.fx_rates r ON r.currency = f.currency WHERE f.facility_type = 'Revolver'), 0) AS undrawn_revolver_usd

question: How accurate were the weekly cash forecasts for each entity over the last 12 weeks?
referenceSql: SELECT e.name AS entity, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(ABS(f.actual_net_cash_usd - f.forecast_net_cash_usd) / f.forecast_net_cash_usd), 1) AS avg_error_pct FROM pg.treasury.cash_forecasts f JOIN pg.treasury.entities e ON e.entity_id = f.entity_id GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY avg_error_pct DESC

question: Which entities' forecasts have missed by more than 15% on average?
referenceSql: SELECT e.name AS entity, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(ABS(f.actual_net_cash_usd - f.forecast_net_cash_usd) / f.forecast_net_cash_usd), 1) AS avg_error_pct FROM pg.treasury.cash_forecasts f JOIN pg.treasury.entities e ON e.entity_id = f.entity_id GROUP BY e.name HAVING AVG(ABS(f.actual_net_cash_usd - f.forecast_net_cash_usd) / f.forecast_net_cash_usd) > 0.15 ORDER BY avg_error_pct DESC
